input.tender_text: A central PSU tender for managed IT services has an estimated value of ₹6 crore and a 36-month term. Performance security is 10% of contract value. Liquidated damages are 0.5% of delayed milestone value per week, capped at 10% of contract value. Each data breach attracts a ₹25 lakh penalty. The supplier gives an uncapped indemnity for third-party claims and data loss. The PSU may terminate for convenience with 15 days' notice and no lost-profit compensation. Courts at New Delhi have exclusive jurisdiction. The excerpt contains no arbitration clause, no aggregate limitation of liability, no force-majeure clause, and no cure period before termination for breach.
input.company_profile: The bidder can provide the performance security. Its board policy requires aggregate liability capped at annual contract fees, at least 30 days to cure remediable breach, and mutual indemnities. Cyber insurance cover is ₹2 crore. The company has not approved uncapped liability.

reference_answer:
## Risk rating
HIGH / CONDITIONAL. Do not accept the contract unchanged because the uncapped indemnity and absent aggregate limitation of liability conflict with board policy and exceed the ₹2 crore cyber cover.

## Clause review
| Clause | Tender position | Exposure | Rating | Action |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Contract value | ₹6 crore | Material | Medium | Confirm final value |
| Term | 36-month term | Long exposure | Medium | Price escalation review |
| Performance security | 10% | ₹60 lakh security | Medium | Treasury approval |
| Liquidated damages | 0.5% weekly, cap 10% | Up to ₹60 lakh | High | Narrow trigger |
| Data breach | ₹25 lakh each | Repeated exposure | High | Add aggregate cap |
| Indemnity | Uncapped indemnity | Unlimited | Critical | Make mutual and capped |
| Convenience termination | 15 days | Stranded cost | High | Add transition payment |
| Jurisdiction | New Delhi courts | Litigation cost | Medium | Accept or negotiate |
| Liability cap | Not found in tender | Unlimited aggregate risk | Critical | Add annual-fees cap |
| Cure period | Not found in tender | Immediate termination risk | High | Add 30 days |
| Arbitration | Not found in tender | Court-only dispute route | Medium | Add arbitration |
| Force majeure | Not found in tender | Unallocated delay risk | High | Add clause |

## Missing clauses
An aggregate limitation of liability, arbitration clause, force-majeure clause and cure period are Not found in tender. Lost-profit compensation on convenience termination is expressly unavailable.

## Pre-bid queries
1. Will the PSU amend the limitation of liability so aggregate supplier liability is capped at annual contract fees, with any negotiated exceptions stated exhaustively?
2. Will the PSU provide at least 30 days to cure a remediable breach before termination, except for an irremediable security event?
3. Will the PSU make indemnities mutual, limit them to third-party claims caused by the indemnifying party, and apply an agreed aggregate cap?
4. Will the PSU add an arbitration and force-majeure mechanism and provide payment for committed transition costs following convenience termination?

## Action plan
Legal must submit the four queries, quantify worst-case exposure, and obtain board approval for any deviation. Finance must confirm the ₹60 lakh performance security and compare the ₹2 crore insurance cover with breach exposure. Bid Manager must keep the decision CONDITIONAL until the uncapped positions are amended or expressly approved.
